title: Consensus Pituitary Atlas, a scalable resource for annotation, novel marker discovery and analyses in pituitary gland research
authors: Kövér B; Willis TL; Sherwin O; Kaufman-Cook J; Kemkem Y; Vazquez Segoviano M; Lodge EJ; Zamojski M; Mendelev N; Zhang Z; Smith GR; Bernard DJ; Lu H; Sealfon SC; Ruf-Zamojski F; Andoniadou CL
one_liner_zh: 该研究构建垂体单细胞图谱并利用机器学习进行细胞注释，虽涉及转录因子关联分析，但核心是单细胞图谱资源，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究。
abstract:
Summary

Previous single-cell profiling studies of the pituitary gland have yielded minimally reproducible insights largely due to their low statistical power and methodological inconsistencies. To address this problem, we generated a uniformly pre-processed Consensus Pituitary Atlas (CPA) using all existing mouse pituitary single-cell datasets (267 biological replicates, >1.1 million high-quality cells). The CPA revealed novel cell typing and lineage markers, including low-expression transcripts that previous analyses could not detect. The scale of the CPA enabled the development of machine learning models to automate and standardize cell type annotation and doublet identification for future studies. Leveraging the curated metadata, we identified sex-biased and age-dependent gene expression patterns at cell type resolution. To identify drivers of cell fates, first we determined consensus cell communication patterns. Secondly, we used RNA-sequencing and chromatin accessibility data to identify transcription factors associated with cell fates across modalities. The epitome platform acts as an interface with the CPA, allowing streamlined user-friendly analyses.

Highlights

Uniform processing of 267 mouse pituitary single-cell datasets (>1.1M cells) The statistical power enabled cell type, sex- and age-specific marker discovery Machine learning models facilitate doublet detection and cell typing in new datasets epitome platform provides programming-free data access and visualizations
abstract_zh:
摘要

先前对垂体进行的单细胞分析研究，由于统计功效低和方法学不一致，所得结果的可重复性极低。为解决此问题，我们利用所有现有小鼠垂体单细胞数据集（267个生物学重复，>110万个高质量细胞），构建了一个统一预处理的共识垂体图谱（Consensus Pituitary Atlas, CPA）。CPA揭示了新的细胞类型和谱系标记，包括先前分析无法检测到的低表达转录本。CPA的规模使得开发机器学习模型成为可能，以自动化和标准化未来研究中的细胞类型注释和双联体识别。利用整理的元数据，我们在细胞类型分辨率下识别了性别偏向和年龄依赖的基因表达模式。为确定细胞命运的驱动因素，我们首先确定了共识细胞通讯模式。其次，我们利用RNA测序和染色质可及性数据，跨模态识别与细胞命运相关的转录因子。epitome平台作为与CPA交互的界面，支持简化且用户友好的分析。

亮点

对267个小鼠垂体单细胞数据集（>110万个细胞）进行统一处理 统计功效支持细胞类型、性别和年龄特异性标记的发现 机器学习模型促进新数据集中的双联体检测和细胞分型 epitome平台提供无需编程的数据访问和可视化
